title: Welcome to Capital Painters : Capitalpainters
body:
Quality that stands out

Capital Painters are a London based company that specialises solely in painting and decorating.  We operate throughout all the London boroughs and believe in offering a professional, friendly, honest service every time, from the quotation stage right through to the finishing coats.

We are also accredited by Which? and Trust Mark and are members of the Dulux Select Decorators.

What you get
Fully Insured
Competitive Pricing
Outstanding Service
Interior / Exterior

Capital Painters carry out all aspects of interior and exterior painting and decorating. Anything from painting a garden shed, to a 4 storey town house, inside and out, we’ll cover it!

'
Commercial / Residential

We work on projects in both the residential and commercial sectors of painting and decorating; so if there's anything from an office space that needs brightening up, to a spare bedroom in a London flat, to a shop interior that needs redecorating, you can call us.

Excellence in Workmanship

Capital Painters' main aim has always been to deliver the highest of standards, on every job, every time. We won’t sign off on a job until you’re 100% happy. As we have been fully vetted and accredited by Dulux, Which? and Trust mark, you’ll have that extra peace of mind that one needs when hiring a decorator.
